title: Full-size screenshots in a browsable lightbox (arrows + D-pad)
description: The media strip's tap-to-expand now becomes a real viewer: full-resolution images lazy-loaded through URLCache the moment a page is opened (cached thumb until it lands), next/previous with on-screen arrows or the controller D-pad, photo counter, Esc/secondary-click/backdrop to close. SteamStoreInfo records each screenshot's full URL (schema v3, refetch-through as entries expire), so the strip itself stays 6 cheap thumbnails.
commit_message: Full-size screenshots with a browsable, controller-aware lightbox
